title: [v0.4.x] Inspect: present complete source-neutral findings
author: mcpdev80
body:
## Aufräumprüfung 15.10.2026

Am aktuellen develop `33b7ca94b42cc45e908c0d964cfbe0cc8349f231` ist die relevante Entscheidungslogik weiterhin vorhanden; kein Abschluss allein wegen des Alters oder alter Fix-Branches.

Vorhandene Vorarbeit vor Neuimplementierung prüfen:
- `fix/750-source-neutral-inspect-summary` — `4c810c9f749eaaba9f755c628df22770826c3e05`
- `fix/750-source-neutral-inspect-summary-v0421-r2` — `e73bc60595a9426242ec1cd1e0883377cf91ab91`
- `fix/750-source-neutral-inspect-summary-v0421` — `7ffe2417587d0cab80f04808e64187d72b3b0668`

Diese Branches sind gegenüber develop divergiert; weder komplette Integration noch sichere Löschbarkeit ist durch Ancestry belegt. Kein pauschaler Merge/Rebase. Gezielt brauchbare Änderungen mit dem aktuellen Vertrag vergleichen. Keine neuen Tests in dieser Hygiene-Prüfung gestartet.

---

## Current triage — outstanding pre-freeze work

Milestone: **v0.4.x**; final semantic acceptance: #174. Original v0.4.20/v0.4.21/v0.4.24 references below describe the historical report, not proof of completion or a new release assignment.

The original defect remains visible in [inspect.go at `1b1ae323`](https://github.com/mcpdev80/baseharbor/blob/1b1ae323284d436f379777a3ab65b37072df14c3/internal/repositoryinspect/inspect.go): shared service/port/health projection and workload log suggestion still depend on `SelectedCompose`. Keep open; require source-neutral Compose/Quadlet/Kubernetes projection and focused parity evidence before closure.

---

## Bug

`baha app inspect` correctly normalizes Compose, repository-authored Quadlet and raw Kubernetes sources into `workload_evidence`, but its shared summary projections remain gated by `SelectedCompose != ""`.

This makes functionally equivalent Quadlet/Kubernetes repositories under-report compared with Compose.

### Confirmed on

- v0.4.20 release commit: `12ebe1a87afdf82923a0c341bcc90578005d79ab`
- current `develop`: still present
- built-in parity fixtures: `testdata/adoption-parity/{compose,quadlet,kubernetes}`

### Current behavior

For Quadlet/Kubernetes, normalized components correctly contain ports, exposure, health/readiness and `infrastructure_class`, while top-level/shared projections can remain empty:

- `ports`
- `health_checks`
- `workload_services`
- `infrastructure_services`
- capability `findings`

Human output therefore omits sections such as Published ports / Health checks / Capabilities even though the source-neutral evidence already contains those facts.

### Root cause

`internal/repositoryinspect/inspect.go`:

- `NormalizeWorkloadSource(...)` correctly fills `result.WorkloadEvidence`.
- `result.SelectedCompose` is set only for Compose.
- summary projection is inside `if result.SelectedCompose != ""`.

This violates the v0.4.20 source-neutral inspect/init contract.

## Required fix

Use normalized `WorkloadEvidence.Components` as the canonical source for shared summary fields for all supported source adapters.

Compose-specific parsing may remain only for details that do not yet exist in normalized evidence (for example database bootstrap implementation details), but must not determine whether shared semantic summaries exist.

### Acceptance

- [ ] Compose, Quadlet and Kubernetes parity fixtures produce equivalent shared summary semantics.
- [ ] Ports are projected from normalized component evidence for all source families.
- [ ] Health/readiness is projected for all source families.
- [ ] Workload vs infrastructure component classification is projected for all source families.
- [ ] Capability findings implied by normalized infrastructure classes are source-neutral.
- [ ] Workload log suggestion is not Compose-only.
- [ ] Human / JSON / MCP consume the same Result semantics.
- [ ] No repository mutation is introduced.
- [ ] Existing Compose behavior remains green.
- [ ] Focused repositoryinspect tests and full Go tests/vet pass.

Release parent: #569
Semantic acceptance: #174
Source-neutral contract predecessor: #519
